name: RESET - Trajectory of life
overview: My name is Thierry Donard. I’m a filmmaker. For the past 30 years, I have traveled the world with my team to film athletes pushing their limits on our changing planet. Beyond their feats, they are incredible men and women that have chosen to experience what few of us ever will. I have dedicated my life to bring the audience as close as possible to these unique athletes. This is their world.
